catalog.help: Remove dbg! or replace it with intentional logging.
catalog.title: Leftover dbg! debugging macro
catalog.not_a_defect_when: The dbg! sits in test code or a throwaway example where printing intermediate values to stderr is the point, and it never reaches library or shipped binary code.

catalog.help: Replace todo! with the intended implementation or remove the reachable placeholder.
catalog.title: Leftover todo! placeholder
catalog.not_a_defect_when: The todo! sits on a path shipped builds cannot reach, such as a stub behind an unreleased feature flag or in a test helper, and a tracking issue is referenced next to it.

catalog.help: Implement this code path or remove the reachable placeholder.
catalog.title: Leftover unimplemented! placeholder
catalog.not_a_defect_when: The unimplemented! marks a trait method the type deliberately does not support, such as an optional method in a test double, and callers are documented never to reach it.

catalog.help: Replace the unbounded version requirement with the minimum compatible version intended by the project.
catalog.title: Registry dependency accepting any version
catalog.not_a_defect_when: The requirement sits in an unpublished internal tool built only with a committed Cargo.lock and --locked, so the lockfile is the real pin and no consumer resolves the open requirement.

catalog.help: Set rev to the full 40-character commit SHA intended by the project.
catalog.title: Git dependency pinned by branch or tag
catalog.not_a_defect_when: The tag lives in a repository the team controls where tags are immutable by policy, and Cargo.lock is committed, so the resolved commit is already fixed for every build.

catalog.help: Keep TLS verification enabled and configure the required trust roots or server name instead.
catalog.title: TLS certificate or hostname verification turned off
catalog.not_a_defect_when: The client only talks to a local test server with a self-signed certificate, in test code or behind an explicit opt-in flag production builds never set.

catalog.help: Avoid the shell and pass values as separate Command arguments to a fixed program; otherwise apply shell-specific escaping at the trust boundary.
catalog.title: Shell command string built from runtime values
catalog.not_a_defect_when: Every interpolated value is program-controlled, such as a path from CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR in a build script or a subcommand chosen from a fixed enum, so no untrusted input reaches the shell.
